rationale: The supplied reviewed context only admits the original selected draft as metadata and explicitly marks the successor as not admitted, while the requested change also introduces a root previous_result binding that cannot be justified from the supported graph primitives without inventing a new graph or unsupported dependency. Because the reviewed runtime inventory supports only the original single-step seed-to-finish graph and no capability is needed beyond the already pinned seed tool, the supportable action is to abstain rather than fabricate a revised campaign or unsupported capability request.
